northpoints: Make Minecraft movement feel like a complete high-skill urban street-sports game rather than a vehicle gimmick.
Preserve normal Minecraft and modded combat while skating, rollerblading, skateboarding or riding BMX.
Ship high-fidelity equipment, animation and audiovisual presentation with no placeholder-quality core assets.
Build a living street-culture ecosystem of gangs, music, graffiti, rivalry, reputation, minigames, and ultra-rare encounters without replacing vanilla or mod-owned mobs.

Make gangification persistent and physical: actual JetSetCraft Street Gear on the original mob is what makes it a gang rider, and only actual gear removal/stolen gear/breakage/unequip restores its normal non-gang state.
Make installed mods and dimensions feel naturally absorbed into JetSetCraft through data-driven optional compatibility and a runtime Mob Atlas.
Perfect Forge 1.20.1 first, then carry the architecture forward to newer Minecraft versions.
feature_pillars: first-class vanilla/Forge/Create rail grinding and transfers
Boombox street-jam challenges and gang music
persistent equipment-bound mob gangification using Street Gear rather than event-only conversion
natural mob Street Gear acquisition through native pickup/steal, dropped-gear contact, direct interaction, and dispenser/redstone
species-aware Ground Contact / Ride Rigs for bipeds, quadrupeds, multi-leg mobs, body-contact creatures, juveniles, and modded animals
gang reputation, rivalry, membership and renameable crew aliases
competitive gang AI and street minigames
adult, Junior/Baby and installed-mod Mob Atlases
guardrails: Weapon use never implicitly clears locomotion state.
Ride clips do not own weapon arms by default.
Do not downgrade core models to low-detail cuboids or token placeholders.
Preserve asset provenance and source derivatives separately.
Use the project-owner-supplied JetSetCraft artwork as the exact canonical mod icon/cover source, with deterministic resize/crop derivatives only.
Support custom-player-renderer ecosystems such as YSM without making ride gear or movement animations disappear.
Never replace, registry-override, or unnecessarily subclass vanilla or mod-owned mobs for gang compatibility; attach JetSetCraft-owned state to the original entity.
A challenge/event is never itself a mob-conversion trigger. Actual JetSetCraft Street Gear presence is the persistent Rider/Gang Form trigger.
Ending an event tears down only transient challenge state; it must never remove persistent Street Gear or gang affiliation while the gear remains equipped.
Use source-owned mob pickup behavior when it exists and additive JetSetCraft item/dispenser behavior when it does not; never rewrite mob AI merely to equip gear.
Never assume a two-legged humanoid rig for animals or modded mobs; map ride gear to actual ground/contact anatomy with safe generic fallbacks and curated adapters.
Optional mods remain optional and must not be hard classloaded when absent.
Durable gang progression keys from stable namespaced gang IDs; display names remain data-driven and safely renameable.
acceptance_signals: A player can maintain momentum through ground, air, grind and wall-ride transitions.
A player can aim/fire/reload TACZ while a JetSetCraft ride state remains active.
Inline, quad, board and BMX are mechanically and visually distinct.
Graffiti persists in-world and can be repainted/removed.
A rider can grind vanilla/Forge rails and Create straight, diagonal, sloped, junction, and Bezier tracks without flattening the path to X/Z.
A rider can perform rail tricks and hop/transfer off a grind while preserving momentum and combo state.
CI produces a Forge 1.20.1 jar from a clean checkout.
A clean build can derive Forge/distribution branding from the exact owner-supplied artwork without AI regeneration or stylistic reinterpretation.
Ride state, combat pose composition, and visible ride gear remain functional when supported custom player renderers are active.

A vanilla or mod-owned mob can acquire Street Gear, remain persistently gangified across event end, chunk reload and save/restart, then return to its original behavior only when the gear is actually removed/stolen/broken/unequipped.
Fox/Allay/native pickup, dropped-gear contact, direct player equip, and dispenser/redstone paths can equip compatible mobs without replacing their source AI.
Biped, quadruped, multi-leg/body-contact, juvenile, and optional-mod animals use sensible species-aware ride contact rigs without forced humanoid assumptions or source renderer mutation.
The Boombox can start random and mob-targeted gang challenges with synchronized gang music metadata and cinematic entrances.
Players can change reputation, join every gang over time, betray/reconcile with gangs, and rename a Friendly gang without breaking stable progression identity.
The Gang Atlas covers vanilla adult crews, valid Junior/Baby variants, and safe detected mob types from installed optional mods.
